{{samename|[[Gym Leader]] who replaces [[Koga]]|Janine}} [[Image:Janina.png|thumb|250px|Janina]] '''Janina''' (Japanese: '''コナツ''' ''Konatsu'') is one of [[Jasmine]]'s young apprentices at the [[Olivine City|Olivine]] [[Gym]], and a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. ==History== Janina greeted {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} when they first arrived at the [[Olivine Gym]] in ''[[EP208|Fight for the Light!]]''. She posed as the [[Gym Leader]] and challenged Ash to a {{pkmn|battle}}. The real Gym Leader, [[Jasmine]], arrived and stopped the match immediately. Janina apologized to Ash and revealed that she had cheated by putting water-resistant polish on her {{p|Onix}}. Jasmine also sent her away from the Gym to do some thinking about her actions. Later, Janina rushed onto the scene after noticing smoke fumes pouring out of the [[Olivine Lighthouse|Shining Lighthouse]]. She and her Onix stopped {{TRT}} from stealing Jasmine's sick {{p|Ampharos}}, [[Amphy|Sparkle]], before Ash sent the trio blasting off. Janina's actions led Jasmine to forgive her young apprentice for her earlier misbehavior. She was then tasked with picking up some [[Secret Medicine|medicine]] from [[Cianwood City]] to help Sparkle recover from its illness. Brock and his friends also joined Janina, after Ash was informed of the [[Cianwood Gym]] while he waited to challenge Jasmine. The [[EP209|following episode]], Janina obtained the ordered medicine from the Cianwood pharmacy and left for Olivine City on an express service. She later contacted Ash to inform him that she had returned to Olivine. She also explained that Sparkle had received its medicine, but Jasmine was still needing time for herself to recover. In the meantime, the group decided to travel through the [[Whirl Islands]]. Ash received another call from Janina in ''[[EP223|Throwing in the Noctowl]]''. She revealed that Jasmine was now accepting challengers, so Ash and his friends took a plane ride and arrived into Olivine City later that day. Janina waved to the plane as it soared over the Shining Lighthouse. She also helped during Jasmine and Ash's Gym battle in ''[[EP224|Nerves of Steelix!]]'' by acting as the [[Battle judge|referee]]. One of her dreams is to become a strong [[Pokémon Trainer]], and Ash told her that he would eventually come back to battle her when she became stronger. ==Character== Janina is bubbly. She follows [[Jasmine]]'s advice and goes out of her way to support her mentor. Aware of Jasmine's ongoing concerns for her ill {{p|Ampharos}}, [[Amphy|Sparkle]], Janina was the main point of contact and kept {{Ash}} updated while he and {{ashfr}} ventured through the [[Whirl Islands]]. In her [[EP208|debut appearance]], Janina was shown to be impulsive and set on proving herself to Jasmine. Though her attempt to impersonate the [[Gym Leader]] and admission of cheating was not taken lightly. Janina later sought {{an|Brock}}'s advice on becoming a stronger {{pkmn|Trainer}}, and he advised her to improve her bond with her {{p|Onix}} and focus on improving its strengths to overcome its weaknesses. The advice resonated with Janina, and she went on to use her Onix's length to take on {{TRT}} who were getting away in their [[Team Rocket's mechas|Meowth balloon]]. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Janina's {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}. {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Janina |pkmn=Onix |type1=Rock |type2=Ground |img=Janina Onix.png |epnum=EP208 |epname=Fight for the Light |vajp=Toshihiko Nakajima |vaen=Toshihiko Nakajima |desc={{p|Onix}} is Janina's only known Pokémon. It first appeared when Janina posed as [[Jasmine]] and had a [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} with {{Ash}}, in which she cheated by coating Onix in a water-resistant polish beforehand. Ash called out his {{AP|Totodile}} and had him use {{m|Water Gun}}, which did no damage because of the polish. Onix then {{m|Tackle}}d Totodile and [[Fainting|knocked him out]]. Ash then sent out {{AP|Pikachu}}, but the real Jasmine interrupted the match. Jasmine then told Janina to scrub the polish off Onix, which she later did. Later, when {{TRT}} were causing havoc in the [[Olivine Lighthouse|Shining Lighhouse]], Onix saw the smoke caused by {{TP|James|Weezing}}, so Janina decided to go and investigate. She found Team Rocket in their {{DL|Team Rocket's mechas|Meowth Balloon}}. [[Jessie]] ordered {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} to use {{m|Poison Sting}}, which Onix deflected. Team Rocket tried to escape over the sea where Onix couldn't go. Onix went on the tsunami barriers and swung its body around latching onto Arbok. Janina used Onix's body as a step ladder, which allowed her to break {{an|Brock}} and [[Amphy|Sparkle]] out of their cage. Onix then swung them away and sent them blasting off. Onix made a brief cameo in ''[[EP224|Nerves of Steelix!]]''. It tried to Tackle Team Rocket's Wobbuffet robot, but the mecha's titanium body proved too tough for it. Onix's known moves are {{m|Tackle}} and {{m|Wrap}}{{tt|*|Onix cannot learn Wrap legally in the games.}}.}} As Janina offered a 3-on-3 match, Janina has at least two other Pokémon with her. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{rock color}}|bordercolor={{rock color light}} |ja=笹本優子 ''Yūko Sasamoto'' |en=[[Kerry Williams]] |ar=إيمان بيطار ''Iman Bitar'' |cs=Jana Páleníčková |pt_br=Fernanda Bullara |es_eu=Cristina Yuste |es_la=Lupita Leal ([[EP208]]-[[EP209]])
